title: Publish to trunk through one loop

intentCoverage.report:
**Caught.** The maintained contention test catches loss of the required replay and second push after a first non-fast-forward rejection. This observation covers the managed delivery path exercised by that test.

For story `SEED-423#publish-to-trunk-through-one-loop` at `0b70c7a0fdbfc21762abca382a6276430bbc6d0d`, the preserved promise is that delivery replays and rechecks only its owned suffix once and stops recoverably after a second rejection. The test `second push rejection preserves the first rewritten candidate and reports contention` uses a local managed delivery fixture with one unpublished backlog increment and two writers advancing the same trunk. Its assertions also check the preserved candidate's exact parent and the independently accepted second writer's tip.

In an isolated detached checkout, changed only `Distribution/src/skills/dough-execute-plan/scripts/publication-loop.mjs`, replacing `retryRejected || recoverPushFailure ? 1 : 0` with `recoverPushFailure ? 1 : 0`. The fault removes the increment's retry after its initial rejection. This exercises the promised rewrite and retry directly. Raising the retry limit would first repeat a fixture writer's unchanged commit, which would fail in fixture setup before the excess push.

Ran the same maintained selection three times with Bash 5 on PATH and the AC sleep guard.

```sh
caffeinate -s -i env PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/bash/bin:$PATH" bash scripts/test.sh Distribution/tests/skills/dough-execute-plan/execution-increment-managed-delivery-reconciliation-stops.test.mjs
```

All three cases passed at baseline and after restoration. The faulted run failed only the named contention case, at line 213, where `assert.equal(delivered.reconciliations, 1)` observed zero. Independent Git Trace2 records showed two rejected exact-SHA pushes to `refs/heads/main` in the contention path at baseline and after restoration, with a different SHA on the second push. The faulted run issued only the first rejected exact-SHA push. The original bytes and clean checkout status matched after restoration. The scratch checkout was removed after the restored pass.

**Next proof action.** Retain the existing assertion. No new or stronger proof is needed for the observed missing-retry fault.

**Prior disposition.** The slice consolidated the duplicate direct contention case into the managed delivery case. This check independently confirms the retained replay assertion catches the missing retry. It introduces no repair disposition.

- **Test runtime.** 18.8 seconds total (measured), from the runner's job durations of 7.6 seconds baseline, 4.9 seconds faulted, and 6.3 seconds restored.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable. The check ran without human interaction and no human-effort measurement was taken.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable. No separate measure of active agent work was recorded.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 116754 ms (measured), from 1795582235849 to 1795582352603 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

Wrap-up disposition — Checked 0b70c7a0fdbfc21762abca382a6276430bbc6d0d. Caught. No follow-up.
